rules.note: Each figure covers a finished ISO week or calendar month, per app and for all apps together; a count under 10 shows as "<10" (and when only one app is hidden beside a published total, the smallest other app figure is hidden too, so nothing can be subtracted out), and a retention share is published only for a cohort of at least 10 installs.

metrics.title: Weekly active installs
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. Each install reports once per week, so a week still running is a partial count.

metrics.title: New installs
metrics.caveat: Only installs that ran a version with Lifestream and left usage counts on. App Store downloads are the downloads metric.

metrics.title: Purchases
metrics.caveat: First purchases of a subscription and one-time purchases as Apple notifies the ledger; renewals are not counted. Production only.

metrics.title: Refunds
metrics.caveat: Production only; the day Apple told the ledger, not the day of the purchase.

metrics.title: AI requests
metrics.caveat: Chat requests only; image generations are not counted here.

metrics.title: Active subscriptions
metrics.caveat: Production only, counted from the transactions the ledger has; a subscription bought before the ledger existed counts from its first renewal the ledger saw.

metrics.title: Monthly active installs
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. A month still running is a partial count.

metrics.title: Week-1 retention
metrics.caveat: The share of a week's new installs that are active again the next week. The period is the install week; a cohort under 10 installs shows "<10", and a value appears once that next week has finished.

metrics.title: Week-4 retention
metrics.caveat: The share of a week's new installs still active four weeks later. The period is the install week; a cohort under 10 installs shows "<10", and a value appears once that fourth week has finished.
